goals.objective: Read-only verification task: Check whether the previously diagnosed causes for YOLO fusion results not appearing in RViz are actual causes. Do not modify production code. Deliverable: evidence-backed finding report with exact fix locations only. Tier: HEAVY because this is ROS/Python/Gazebo/RViz integration debugging and the user explicitly requested confirmation. Success criteria: C1 prove or refute that scripts/hyu-docker fusion-bg does not enable bbox_source:=yolov8 and therefore does not launch yolov8_bbox_node or route /yolo_bounding_boxes into fusion; evidence by parsed launch/script CLI transcript under .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-c1.txt. C2 prove or refute that graph_slam RViz config disables Fusion Cones /cones/viz; evidence by parsed RViz config CLI transcript under .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-c2.txt. C3 attempt runtime or partial-runtime confirmation of ROS launch graph feasibility without code edits; if full runtime is blocked by missing Docker/ROS surface, capture the blocking output and combine with static parsed evidence under .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-c3.txt.
